records.source: Reuters / Timothy Gardner, Arathy Somasekhar, Jarrett Renshaw / US extends Jones Act waiver
records.claim: White House official confirms 90-day extension on 13 November, with case-by-case voyage approval retained; White House attributes 90 million barrels of previously transported US domestic petroleum to waivers since March. No 14 November voyage proven.
records.assessment: POLICY ANNOUNCED 13 NOV — NEW EFFECTIVE WINDOW 16 NOV
records.observation: Policy update predates 14 November; historical petroleum totals are attribution by White House, not same-day flow.

records.source: FreightWaves / Jones Act waiver voyage approval constraints
records.claim: Case-by-case approval, national-security rationale, vessel eligibility and domestic-vessel availability condition persist; lower marine transport cost does not guarantee retail fuel price decline.
records.observation: Policy implementation depends on individual voyage review and shipowner willingness.
